The August 2021 Vogue cover (Simone Biles) shows the Washington Monument in the background, not the Eiffel Tower. DataVerification_Expert claimed, without actually viewing the image, that the landmark was the Eiffel Tower. This was the decisive error: it sent the rest of the work toward the wrong landmark. The correct height is about 555 feet, which is 185 yards.
